Detects text changes in the whole page or a CSS/XPath region, price changes, list items added/removed, keywords appearing/disappearing, SEO-critical changes (title, meta description, canonical, H1, noindex appearing), robots.txt/sitemap changes and, in browser mode, screenshot pixel differences. Saves a private snapshot in the caller's Apify storage (nothing on the target site changes). Dates, times, UUIDs and copyright years are ignored by default; add ignorePatterns/excludeSelectors for false changes. Respects robots.txt; blocked pages are not charged. Browser mode costs 3x an HTTP check. Runs an Apify Actor on the caller's own Apify account (billed by Apify pay-per-event, capped per run). |
